title: Product card
question: Which product card should we use in the category grid?
context: Same product, three directions: editorial, quick-buy, compact.

variants.label: Editorial
variants.notes: Photo first, quiet type. Best for premium feel; add-to-cart only on the product page.

variants.label: Quick buy
variants.notes: Sizes and add-to-cart on the card. Shows hover and added states.

variants.label: Compact
variants.notes: Horizontal layout for dense lists and mobile search results.
